none: PAS FindID 1029530: Roman coin: denarius, possibly of Julia Mamea
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of an indeterminate female ruler, possibly Severan issue of 193-227, just possibly Julia Mamea (221-235), Reece period 11. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right. Obverse inscription: (--) MEA AVG. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left with transverse sceptre. Reverse inscription: [--]A. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.51gms, die axis: 6
